suppress.notes: CVE-2026-109344, -109345, -116802, -116803, -116804: DOMPurify 3.4.13 inside the swagger-ui 5.32.14 webjar (from springdoc 3.1.1). Fixed in DOMPurify 3.4.17; the newest webjar (5.34.0) still bundles 3.4.16, so no upgrade or override is available yet (ADR-0004). Not reachable as Swagger UI uses DOMPurify: its only sanitize() call takes a string, without IN_PLACE, SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES, PARSER_MEDIA_TYPE or RETURN_DOM, and its only hook adds rel="noopener" without removing nodes. The input is our own OpenAPI document.
